section10.h2: The dentist who plans your case is the dentist who treats it
section10.text: Dr. Sean Sunyoto leads Invisalign treatment at Legacy Dental Pasadena himself. He scans your teeth, designs the movement, and reviews every set of aligners with you. Nothing is handed off to a coordinator and no part of the plan is decided before you have seen it.
section10.text2: Align Technology names its highest-volume, most experienced providers Diamond, and Legacy Dental Pasadena holds that status for 2026. In practice it means the difficult cases have been seen before, and that the plan you are shown is built on a lot of finished ones.
section10.credential-text2: iTero digital scanning, no putty impressions
section10.credential-text4: In-house 3D printing for aligners and retainers
_video-note: Vimeo id 1183600276, 'New - Legacy Dental Pasadena Invisalign Process', 154s, the practice's own film and the only LANDSCAPE Invisalign video of the six. The other five are portrait, which is why the consultation page treats them as a vertical wall rather than a 16:9 grid. Webflow has no iframe element and a native video element's URL is unreachable over the Data API, so the slot is a poster that LINKS to the film.

section-mist12.review-quote: Very experienced, high-volume Invisalign office. They made me feel comfortable, explained the process clearly, and gave me confidence moving forward with treatment.
section-mist12.review-quote2: The way the treatment was set up was just fantastic. The instructions were so easy to follow. Dr. Sunyoto clearly knows his stuff. The Invisalign process was straightforward and really tailored for me.
section-mist12.review-quote3: I always feel great leaving and knowing my teeth are looking their best. The staff is thorough and friendly, always making sure I feel comfortable. If you're looking for Invisalign or cosmetic dentistry in the Pasadena area, Dr. Sunyoto is definitely the one to see!
